brief.zh: a 说：「b 是无赖。」b 说：「c 是无赖。」c 说：「a 和 b 都是无赖。」把三人的话译成逻辑，接成电路：三人的话都和身份相符的行，输出真。
brief.en: a says: “b is a knave.” b says: “c is a knave.” c says: “a and b are both knaves.” Translate what the three say into logic and wire it: the board outputs true on exactly the rows where what each says fits what they are.

t.en: Three people, and the table has eight rows.

hint.zh: c 的话里，否定管的是哪一部分？
hint.en: In what c says, which part does the negation cover?

hint.zh: 三个人的话各译一句，三句要同时成立。
hint.en: Translate each person’s words on their own; all three must hold at once.

after.zh: 找一行使几句话同时为真，这类问题叫<wiki-ref to="satisfiable"></wiki-ref>问题（SAT）。
after.en: Finding a row on which several sentences are all true is the <wiki-ref to="satisfiable"></wiki-ref> problem (SAT).
